bug_semantics: The DuckDB AWS extension exposed SQL table function load_aws_credentials, which resolved the AWS default credential provider chain (profile files, env, IMDSv2, IRSA, ECS task role, EC2 instance role) and returned access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token, and region as result columns. Named parameter redact_secret (default true) gated only the secret_access_key column; CALL load_aws_credentials(redact_secret=false) emitted the secret in plaintext. That opt-out was independent of DuckDB's later database-wide allow_unredacted_secrets=false policy (AllowUnredactedSecretsSetting), so any principal with SQL execution could dump live AWS credentials without enabling unredacted secrets. The original return path also always printed session_token unredacted. The complete fix deleted the function rather than relying on a bind-time policy check.
flaw_origin: The plaintext-return opt-out was first written in 07991443a7805840aa1c4783b13964c2a53c8700 (PR #8, 2023-08-31, 'also fetch region, update duckdb'): SetAWSCredentialsFunctionData.redact_secret, LoadAWSCredentialsBind parsing of named parameter redact_secret, registration of that named parameter, loaded_secret_access_key / loaded_session_token columns, and LoadAWSCredentialsFun's else-branch that returns load_result.set_secret_access_key when redact_secret is false (src/aws_extension.cpp). Immediate parent 428e7fba74a9833f9e2e771b3eb82ee0ab0bf7b5 only returned loaded_key (access key id) and had no redact_secret knob. 50819051626f99aa92c726d0d9daaeb91d6349bb introduced the earlier load_aws_credentials helper but did not return secret_access_key. reasoning: Vulnerability first: CVE-2026-58139 is a published VulnCheck CNA record (not rejected/withdrawn) for CWE-863 in duckdb/duckdb-aws. The mechanism is a SQL side door around DuckDB secret redaction: load_aws_credentials resolves the host AWS credential chain and, when redact_secret=false, returns secret_access_key (and always returned session_token) in the result set, so allow_unredacted_secrets=false does not bind this function. BIC hunt used advisory refs (PR #156 / 7d04119) then git log -S/-L on the deleted function, not an AI-commit search. The smallest first-write of the vulnerable lines is 07991443a7805840aa1c4783b13964c2a53c8700: it adds redact_secret, the secret/session/region result columns, and the plaintext else-branch. Parent 428e7fba74a9833f9e2e771b3eb82ee0ab0bf7b5 was checked directly and lacks those lines (only loaded_key). PR #8 is a single non-merge commit, so it is not a squash aggregate; the main-branch merge b215537 is not the BIC. 5081905 created load_aws_credentials but did not return the secret; 6bf42d7 is a secrets-manager add-on that kept the same return path; 99e4446 is format-only. PR #154 (5e29945, 2026-06-09) later added Settings::Get<AllowUnredactedSecretsSetting> in LoadAWSCredentialsBind; that is a subsequent incomplete mitigation (session-token redaction was immediately reverted in f9b6f6f; the function remained callable) and is an ancestor of the cited patch, which is why VulnCheck marks all history < 7d04119 affected. Complete fix is PR #156 removing the function: landing merge 7d04119ee8d3f8836e278f0e8cbf21827ff5338b, direct deletion 1000f983b0aa1aa045b4b86e38ef71bdcf98c687.
